author: Yffe
content: Implement L2 Kani-backed bounded checking. thermite-lower/src/l2.rs: lower_l2 emits a #[kani::proof] #[kani::unwind(K)] harness per fn, REUSING the L1 executable lowering (spec_sum recursion, combinator loops, expr/stmt forms) for body+spec fns since Kani checks executable Rust. Type-driven bound inference (REQ-2 headline): infer_symbolic_input keys on the Param's Type — &[T]→symbolic [T;N] array + len<=N, scalar→kani::any() — SHAPE-keyed never name-keyed. SLICE_BOUND N=4. unwind_bound SHAPE-keyed on loop kind: while→N+1 (sum=5), unconditional loop→N+2 (binary_search=6). forge/src/kani.rs: run_kani writes a temp cargo crate, spawns real cargo-kani --output-format terse, checks exit status, parses SUCCESSFUL→L2 / FAILED→counterexample / no-summary→KaniOutput err; ENOENT→KaniAbsent. forge check --level l2 runs check_l2_file; default stays L3 (no auto-degrade, #10). Verified vs real cargo kani 0.67.0.
